builtin_plugin_delta.registration_site: unconditional builtin initializer, registered next to cc-plugin-sec-default, cc-plugin-agents-md, and cc-plugin-telemetry before the CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT gate
builtin_plugin_delta.description: Privacy: asks before a shell or web tool runs with the signed-in account's email address in a call that may leave the machine
builtin_plugin_delta.hook_surface: tool.check over WebBrowser, WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash, Monitor, PowerShell, and Tmux; decision ask when the call input carries the account email
builtin_plugin_delta.reason: Headless selects Read,Glob,Grep and response-only runs with empty tools, so no web or shell tool call can occur on either route. The plugin contributes no MCP server. Hook events reach the stream only through --include-hook-events, which neither route passes.
